node.title: Re^3: Sorting Text File for HTML Output
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Glad to help! One book [id://832725|of many] about more "modern" style Perl is [http://modernperlbooks.com/|Modern Perl].

I would get an error 500 message.

I suspect it might be that you don't have [mod://Data::Dump] installed, but really the first step is to look at the error message, which is probably in your web server's error log. See also [id://165253] and [id://380424].
